$schema_note: Single source of truth for Truewise design tokens (Stage 2). Edit values HERE, then run `make tokens` (or `python -m pipeline.build_tokens`) to regenerate site/styles.css :root AND pipeline/tokens_gen.py. Never hand-edit a colour in styles.css or a pipeline generator: it will drift, which is exactly the bug that shipped ~5,300 OG cards a different blue from the site. `make tokens-check` fails CI if the generated files are stale.
